 ORDER

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.385/2023 dated 12.09.2023 registered at Police Station Dhuma District Seoni for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) & 376(3) of IPC, Sections 3,
4, 5(i) & 6 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(1)(w)(ii) & 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant contends that applicant is in custody since 20.09.2023.

In the meantime, the statement of prosecutrix and her parents have been recorded which has been brought Akash Vishwakarma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14356076/
1 on record along with IA No.3896/2024.

sentences.text: A perusal of the same reflects that the prosecutrix as well as her parents have turned hostile.
Thus, counsel submits that the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
3. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent has opposed the prayer.

4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
5.
A perusal of the statement of the prosecutrix as well as her parents recorded during the course of trial reflect that they have been turned hostile.

The applicant is in custody since 20.09.202 and is aged about 20 years.
6.
Thus, taking into consideration the totality of the circumstances of the case, this Court deem it proper to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
9.
Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.

(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE mn Akash Vishwakarma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14356076/
